comment: Prof Nicholson is the one to take for your language requirement! He cares about your success and is extremely clear and helpful! Easy to get an A if you put your time and effort into it! Best decision taking this class 1st semester fresh year! HUGE GPA boost and great transition into college! My favorite professor yet :)

Best professor i've had at richmond so far (1st semester freshman). I absolutely love Prof. Nicholson. He cares about his students and makes sure everyone thoroughly understands the topics covered. He is clear, helpful, and makes class fly by. Taking LAIS 221 with him was the best decision i've made here! Hope to take more classes with him!!!!
Chillest professor ever. Great quality and teaching techniques combined with super chillness. Def take him you wont regret it
This class was great and he's a great professor, whether you need to take 221 for the gen ed or plan on moving on in spanish this is a great class to take!!

Very nice, easygoing guy. My class got quite attached to him. He makes you participate, but not in a hard or intimidating way(ie. speak to others, read aloud) Do your homework and study and you'll do well. Quizzes are fine, and only on vocab, tests he gives you helpful study guides. Not a boring class, as he has you up and speaking often.
